assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production transparent sprite atlas for a 2D recreation of League of Legends Swarm Warehouse District. Input images 1-3 are STYLE AND SUBJECT REFERENCES ONLY, not edit targets. Create one square 1536x1536 PNG texture atlas with true transparent background, exactly 3 columns and 3 rows of equal 512x512 cells, no grid lines, no text, no logos, no UI, no characters or enemies. Each of the nine cells contains ONE isolated environmental prop, completely contained with 24px clear margins, same hand-painted polished MOBA game texture style, orthographic overhead camera tilted only slightly from vertical (about 70 degrees), north is straight up, not diamond isometric. Match the reference colors and subjects as faithfully as possible: muted gray urban sci-fi stone, white/steel edges, teal/cyan glows, orange industrial accents, realistic clean painted detail. Row 1 col1: original-style circular cyan healing fountain basin with green holographic orb and slim tall silver monolith rising at rear-left, the round basin dominates most of cell; row1 col2: rectangular chamfer-corner turquoise park pond with pale stone rim, lily pads and pink flowers; row1 col3: angular stone-edged planted garden with golden female armored hero statue, dense low green shrubs. Row2 col1: elongated dark industrial facility with large white/gray tower, exposed steel pipes, orange cylindrical tanks and cyan ports, north-south footprint; row2 col2: square compact dark machinery building with three orange-and-white tanks on west edge, cooling fans, gray roof and connected pipes; row2 col3: twin long parallel horizontal industrial silver tanks with orange bands, dark metal foundation and pipes, oriented NW to SE. Row3 col1: dense cluster of leafy green park trees, varied green foliage, visible trunks and subtle small shadows; row3 col2: one long narrow park bench with brown wooden slats and gray stone ends, aligned NORTH-SOUTH, one slim gray street lamp and small cylindrical blue trash bin tightly beside it; row3 col3: angular compact park utility pavilion with gray stepped foundation, teal tinted roof, metallic structure and surrounding shrubs. All props must read as finished game sprites at 128px, coherent overhead lighting from northwest, soft contact shadows only, no terrain rectangles behind props. Transparent alpha outside every isolated asset. Exactly nine separated cells, accurate uniform spacing for deterministic AtlasTexture slicing. Do not reproduce the image frame, branding, border or watermark from the references.

Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE finished transparent game environment sprite: the circular healing fountain from League of Legends Swarm Warehouse District, matching the supplied in-game reference closely: circular gray and silver layered metallic basin/platform, turquoise glowing pool, green holographic spherical orb above center, tall narrow futuristic white/silver monolith with cyan vertical inlay rising from the rear-left, three small white mechanical fixtures around rim, subtle glowing green ring inscriptions. Orthographic camera seen from high above at about 70 degrees, straight north-up, no perspective convergence, matching 2D top-down game. Hand-painted polished MOBA environmental asset, muted gray-white metal and saturated cyan/green glows, sharp readable details. Entire object MUST fit fully inside the canvas with a clear 12% transparent margin on EVERY SIDE including above the tall monolith, no clipping of the top, platform or any shadows. Transparent alpha background, no floor tile, no grass, no characters, no text, no watermark, no logos or frames. The image is a reference for subject/style only, not an edit target. One isolated fountain, not an atlas or collage.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: seamless square 1024x1024 tiling environment material for the non-walkable outer city blocks of League of Legends Swarm Warehouse District in a polished hand-painted top-down 2D game. Straight vertical orthographic bird's-eye view, no perspective. Dense but coherent cool dark slate blue-gray futuristic urban industrial rooftops: a few large flat angular roof panels with pale steel bevels, subtle vents, tightly grouped pipes, dark ducts and thin restrained cyan emissive strips, occasional muted copper trim. Match the elegant painted MOBA map environment finish, clean brush texture, subtle worn edges, ambient occlusion and consistent northwest lighting. Roof panels should form an irregular but seamless repeat across all four image edges. Fully opaque material, fills entire canvas, no transparent areas. No floors/roads, no grass, no water, no fountains, no character figures, no text, no logos, no circles of UI, no large glowing lights. Low contrast enough to frame a brighter playable area.
